question: What is Extraordinary Listening?
short_answer: Extraordinary Listening is the title of Richard Moon's public study PDF *The Power of Extraordinary Listening*, offered on this site as a quantum leap in communication and commonwealth.
answer_markdown:
On the public books index, *The Power of Extraordinary Listening* is listed as a free PDF: "A quantum leap in communication & commonwealth." A companion PDF, *The Business of Listening*, collects conversations with CEOs who used the Listening work.

This knowledge page does not excerpt the PDF body. It points at the already-public listing and the downloadable file so readers can read Moon's own words there.

Listening in the wider teaching is the same move as WIGO and Dialogue: attend to what is actually going on, not only to the stated position.
